lines.text: PARAGRAPH BORDERS: consecutive paragraphs with identical borders and identical side
indents share one box, which holds the space between them and no rule there. A top or bottom
border adds its space and its width to the height of a paragraph.
The paragraph before the boxes.
The first of two paragraphs with identical borders.
The second of two paragraphs with identical borders.
The paragraph between the boxes.
A single paragraph with a border eight points from its text.
The paragraph after the single box.
A paragraph with a blue border.
A paragraph with a border of another colour.
The paragraph after the boxes.
The first of three paragraphs in one box.
The second of three paragraphs in one box, without a fill.
The third of three paragraphs in one box, with spacing of its own.
The paragraph after the box of three.
A paragraph with a box at the margin.
A paragraph with an identical border and another left indent.
A paragraph with an identical border and another right indent.
The paragraph after the indented boxes.
The first of two paragraphs with a rule on the left.
The second of two paragraphs with a rule on the left.
A paragraph with a further rule below.
The last paragraph.
